about:
Texas Microfiber operates from Farmers Branch, Texas. The company is woman-owned, though its founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed. It began as a supplier of microfiber products for car wash and detailing applications.

The company provides a range of microfiber products, including traditional and custom items for vehicle washing and detailing, healthcare and hospital settings, and janitorial and sanitation (JanSan) markets. Its stated capability is full-service carwash microfiber, suggesting it supplies towels, mitts, and related accessories to professional car wash operators. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

Texas Microfiber serves the automotive and car wash industry, as well as healthcare, hospital, and JanSan sectors. Customers include car wash operators, automotive detailers, healthcare facilities, and janitorial supply distributors.

The company emphasizes providing the highest quality products suited to customer needs, offering both traditional and custom product options.
